state:
- The causal object is unnamed Nup98 phosphorylation somewhere in or beside the FG repeats, so the phospho-null and phosphomimetic tests cannot start until an open phosphoproteomic search succeeds. Pre-register a short FG-adjacent proline-directed site list and one kinase-perturbation arm, and keep unguided site discovery as a secondary analysis.
- Selective import failure is measured with a single NLS reporter inside an already stress-granule-independent TDP-43 model, leaving export, passive leak, scaffold disassembly, and a competent S4 sequestration control untested. Add an NES reporter, a passive diffusion probe, a scaffold nucleoporin marker, and a parallel stress-granule model in which the same blockade is expected to restore import.
- The timing claim does not separate demixing-driven Nup98 phosphorylation from the induction stress itself or from the phospho-TDP-43 signal already described in S3. Require uninduced and demixing-blocked sister cultures, a numeric Nup98 occupancy threshold, and a matched phospho-TDP-43 time course before calling the modification initiating.
